item.title: Version 1.0.7
item.description: Historical currency: '1 usd to cny on 5/21/25' or '… on september 2025' pulls the rate from Frankfurter (free ECB history, no key). Auto-refreshes when it arrives — no need to retype. Better date arithmetic: '10/1 + 30 + 25' now advances 55 days from Oct 1. Bare 'm' means metres (SI); type 'mil' or a currency ($5.5m) for million. Currency-math fixed: '$450k - 100k - 10815' computes right. Phone detection tightened (10+ digits, valid NANP/international format) so '7536-4512' stays math. New auto-conversions: 58" → cm, 6' → m, 70 f → C, 5 lb → kg. Contact rows: 'All options…' pops a native menu with Call / Message / FaceTime Video / FaceTime Audio / Copy per phone and email. Dialer now uses Contacts.app (silent immediate Continuity call — no popup). Emoji/unicode grid: press Down to focus (blue) and use L/R/Up/Down to navigate; otherwise arrows drive the search-field cursor.

item.title: Version 1.0.6
item.description: Call button now opens the real 'Call using iPhone?' popup via Safari trampoline. Calendar quick-add: type an event like 'lunch with sara tomorrow 1pm at grand central' or 'Global Entry interview JFK Airport 8:30 Fri' — Beam parses title, time, and full multi-part location. Shift+Enter shows a calendar picker; default calendar configurable in Settings > General > Calendar. New Places section (Apple Maps, US-biased): type an address or venue and Beam returns titled results. Time-zone converter: '12:30pm ny to utah' — supports cities, US states, and TZ identifiers. Contacts with only an organization name (e.g. Fesco) now appear in search. Settings hierarchy cleaned up.

item.title: Version 1.0.5
item.description: Calculator improvements: • Handle ~ (approximately) and currency symbols in × expressions • Fix thousands separators on decimals • Sum/average now work with pasted multi-line columns
